title: Urges the President of the United States, the Director of the National Park Service and the Congress of the United States to provide the funding needed to complete the full historic restoration of the Chateau at Oregon Caves National Monument.

claims.text: HJM 12 was introduced in the House on February 25, 2025.

Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
